headline: Skip: Alpha Tau gets FDA sign-off to enlarge an ongoing device study
reasoning: News item (Benzinga, 08:35 ET): 'Receives FDA Approval For Investigational Device Exemption Supplement To Expand Its U.S. REGAIN Study'
An IDE supplement lets a trial enrol more patients or sites; it is not a product approval and carries no efficacy data
Incremental regulatory housekeeping for an ongoing study
objections: SCOUT: procedural regulatory step, no approval or data
